title: Marco Rubio's SSCI staff seek whistleblowers

tellings.quote: Marco Rubio who you know UFO heads who are deep in the subject have known he's had an interest in the subject since 2017 and has employed his staff at the SSCI and others to go uh find more about whistleblowers for him.

plain: Since 2017, the story goes, Marco Rubio, a US senator, has been quietly interested in UFOs and has had his staff look for whistleblowers. That staff sat on the Senate Select Committee on Intelligence, the Senate panel that oversees the spy agencies. A UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb says this is long known among people deep in the subject, without naming a source, and tells it as a sign that a powerful senator took the topic seriously.
